upstream_release_metadata.note: The official v2.12.0 tag contains inconsistent internal version labels. The executable npm artifact is therefore pinned and independently validated instead of inferred from those labels.

lock.installation_method: isolated npm-exec staging with exact package version; only canonical UI/UX Pro Max assets are promoted
lock.network_behavior: The installer contacts the npm registry for the exact pinned package. Generated search engines use local data and Python standard-library code.
supply_chain_controls: GitHub workflow token removed from installer process
Python compilation and functional smoke tests
mandatory_gates: human approval before publish, merge or deploy
lock.rollback: restore .pefy/backups/ui-ux-pro-max/<timestamp> or revert the installation commits
lock.kill_switch: disable the UI UX Pro Max Sync workflow and revert/remove canonical generated capability files
lock.upgrade_rule: change npm_version_pinned only after provenance review, integrity verification and successful validation in a controlled branch
